title: Whole Cell Protein Extraction and Western Blotting
author: Isabel Lam
materials: Whole-cell protein extraction and Western blotting Author: Alain Ndayisaba Khurana Lab, Brigham and Women’s Hospital 1. Purpose This protocol describes cell lysis for whole-cell protein extraction followed by western blotting using LI-COR Odyssey quantitative western blot. Frozen cell pellets described here are typically iPSC-derived cortical neurons, seeded into a 24 well plate format at 1x10^6 cells per well, and collected for downstream processing at DIV25. 2. Materials iBlot 2 Gel Transfer Device (Thermo Fisher) Odyssey CLx Infrared Imager (LI-COR) 3. Reagents NuPage™ LDS sample buffer (Life Technologies, Cat. # NP0007) cOmplete™ EDTA-free Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (Sigma Aldrich, Cat. # 11873580001) PhosSTOP phosphatase inhibitor cocktail (Sigma Aldrich, Cat. # 4906845001) Pierce™ BCA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Fisher, Cat. # 23227) NuPAGE 4-12% Bis-Tris protein gels (Life Technologies, Cat. # NP0322BOX) NuPAGE MES SDS Running Buffer (Life Technologies, Cat. # NP000202) 4% Paraformaldehyde (Thermo Scientific, Cat. # 28906) LI-COR Odyssey blocking buPer (PBS) (Fisher Scientiﬁc, Cat. # NC9877369) Tween-20 (Fisher Scientiﬁc, Cat. # 50213612) Primary antibody IRDye secondary antibody (Li-COR): e.g., IRDye® 800CW (LI-COR Biosciences, Cat. # 925-32214), IRDye ® 680RD (LI-COR Biosciences, Cat. # 925-68074) 4. Procedure 1. For cell lysis, thaw frozen cell pellets on wet ice 2. Resuspend cell pellets in 100 µL of 1X NuPage™ LDS sample buPer (diluted using dH2O) containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors. 3. Sonicate samples twice for 15 sec with a tip-sonicator at 40% power, keeping sample on ice. 4. Centrifuge samples at maximal speed for 10 min. 5. Transfer the supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube. Discard the cell pellet. 6. To quantify protein concentration, 5 µL of each sample was used in Pierce™ BCA Protein Assay Kit according to manufacturer’s guidelines.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Standards
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of 1X LDS sample buffer containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors to bovine albumin serum (BSA) protein standards to account for LDS dye in absorbance measurement.

steps.title: Perform SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Run protein samples on NuPAGE 4-12% Bis-Tris protein gels using NuPAGE MES SDS Running Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Set aside 30 µg of protein per sample for SDS-PAGE.
Conduct electrophoresis at 150 V for 55 min or until the protein ladder and loading dye indicate sufficient electrophoretic separation.

steps.title: Transfer Proteins to Membrane
steps.instruction: Perform a dry transfer from the polyacrylamide gel to a nitrocellulose membrane using the iBlot 2 Gel Transfer Device.

substeps.instruction: Use preset P0 program: 20V for 1 min, 23V for 4 min, and 25V for 2 min.

steps.title: Fix Membrane (Optional)
steps.instruction: If detecting alpha-synuclein, fix the membrane to improve detection.

substeps.instruction: Incubate membrane in 4% paraformaldehyde in dH2O for 30 min at room temperature with orbital shaking.

steps.title: Wash and Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Prepare the membrane for antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Wash membrane three times for 5 min with PBS.
Block membranes in Li-COR Odyssey blocking buffer (PBS) for 1 h with orbital shaking.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the primary antibody solution overnight at 4°C with orbital shaking.

substeps.instruction: Prepare solution using Odyssey blocking buffer (in PBS), 0.1% Tween-20, and the respective primary antibodies at the desired dilution.

steps.title: Wash Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash membranes four times for 5 min in 0.05% Tween-20/PBS.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate membranes with the secondary antibody solution at room temperature with orbital shaking, protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Prepare solution using Odyssey blocking buffer (TBS), 0.1% Tween-20, and secondary antibody at 1:10,000 dilution.

steps.title: Final Wash
steps.instruction: Wash membranes four times for 5 min in 0.05% Tween-20/PBS.

steps.title: Scan and Quantify Blot
steps.instruction: Detect and analyze the protein bands.

substeps.instruction: Scan the blot using the Odyssey CLx Infrared Imager.
Use ImageStudio software for quantification of bands.
